scope: Read-only review of the appended LW2_INSTALLED_KEEP block against frozen terminal-4 r2, with a tiny local synthetic venv. No wheel build, product execution, full suite, source edit, or Git mutation.

source_file.diff_scope: Only the appended observation/keep block at current lines 387-419 is beyond frozen r2.

findings.detail: copytree(..., symlinks=True) copies the console script bytes without rewriting its pip-generated absolute shebang. The kept observation merely relabels console_script to the copied path; it never executes that copied path or checks its shebang.

kept_observation is a shallow dict copy and only venv/venv_python/console_script are replaced. modules remains payload["modules"], whose __file__ values point into the original temporary environment. The record therefore cannot establish module imports from the copied environment.

The block calls shutil.rmtree(kept_venv) whenever the caller-selected destination already exists. There is no per-run ownership marker, token, identity check, or refusal path. A pre-existing destination can therefore be deleted before copytree.

minimal_fix_recommendations: Use a unique per-run keep destination or a marker containing the current run token; if the requested destination exists without a matching marker, fail safely instead of removing it.

After copying, validate the copied environment itself: execute the copied Python and copied vpwiki-research entry, inspect the copied modules from that run, and record their actual __file__ values and hashes. Do not rewrite observation paths without re-running the checks.

Either regenerate/relocate the console entry shebang for the copied environment or retain the original venv as the tested environment; symlink-preserving copy alone does not create an independently validated venv.
